_comment: Static cue definitions — human-editable, version-controlled. Never hardcode frame numbers. This file defines WHAT to look for; build_cue_map() in animator.py resolves WHERE (frame number) each day.

segment_cues._comment: Segment cues fire at segment boundaries from narration_timing.json — always available, no whisper needed.
segment_cues.label: hook_start

word_cues._comment: Word cues require word_timings.json from word_aligner.py. If absent, these are silently skipped.
word_cues._comment2: occurrence: 0=first match, 1=second, -1=last. offset_frames: shift trigger earlier (<0) or later (>0).
word_cues.label: metric_reveal
